description: This file defines the IDeviceInfo interface and related data structures for device information, capabilities, and system details within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for retrieving device serial number, model, type, firmware, network interfaces, and capabilities.

classes.name: IDeviceInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving detailed device information and system capabilities.

classes.name: IDeviceAudioCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for accessing device audio capabilities and supported audio profiles.

classes.name: IDeviceVideoCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for accessing device video capabilities, supported resolutions, and HDCP support.

methods.name: SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number set by the manufacturer.

methods.name: Sku
methods.description: Provides access to the device model number or SKU.

methods.name: Make
methods.description: Provides access to the device manufacturer.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Provides access to the friendly device model name.

methods.name: DeviceType
methods.description: Provides access to the device type information.

methods.name: SocName
methods.description: Provides access to the SOC Name.

methods.name: DistributorId
methods.description: Provides access to the partner or distributor ID for the device.

methods.name: Brand
methods.description: Provides access to the device brand name.

methods.name: ReleaseVersion
methods.description: Provides access to the release version of the device image.

methods.name: ChipSet
methods.description: Provides access to the device chipset information.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Provides access to firmware version information.

methods.name: SystemInfo
methods.description: Provides general system information such as version, uptime, RAM, and CPU load.

methods.name: SupportedAudioPorts
methods.description: Provides supported audio ports on the device.
